info.name: QA-Demo Project
info.description:
Purpose:
Professional API testing collection for the QA-Demo application.

Application:
https://qademo.com/

Current Phase:
Phase 3 - Postman API Request Implementation

API definitions:
Derived from Phase 2 API Discovery (docs/API_DISCOVERY.md, docs/api-inventory.json). All requests, methods, headers, and bodies in this collection reflect only what was actually discovered/verified in Phase 2 - nothing is invented.

API Base URL:
https://qademo.com/api (environment variable {{apiUrl}})

Authentication:
Bearer access token (Authorization: Bearer {{authToken}}) for user/admin-protected endpoints, obtained from POST /auth/login. Cart endpoints instead require an X-Session-ID header ({{sessionId}}), independent of login state.

Three endpoints (POST /products, PATCH /products/{id}, POST /orders) have a verified method/URL/auth requirement but an undetermined request body schema - see docs/POSTMAN_IMPLEMENTATION.md "Unresolved / Partially Implemented APIs" for details. No fields were invented for these.

No automated test assertions have been added yet - that is Phase 4.

Future phases:
Phase 4 - API Test Automation
Phase 5 - Data Chaining
Phase 6 - Newman
Phase 7 - Git/GitHub
Phase 8 - GitHub Actions / CI/CD

item.name: 01 - Authentication
item.description: Login, logout, token refresh, and current-user endpoints. Verified in Phase 2 API discovery (docs/API_DISCOVERY.md, section 'Authentication').

request.description:
Purpose:
Log in with a username and password.

Method:
POST

Endpoint:
/auth/login

Authentication:
Not required.

Parameters:
None.

Body (required, JSON):
{ "username": string, "password": string } - both required (verified live via Zod validation error when omitted).

Expected response:
200 - { success: true, data: { accessToken, user } } (inferred, not observed live - no valid credentials were available during discovery).
401 - { success: false, error: { code: 'INVALID_CREDENTIALS', message } } (verified live).
400 - Zod validation error shape ({ issues: [...], name: 'ZodError' }) when required fields are missing (verified live).

Note: on a successful login, manually copy the returned accessToken into the `authToken` environment variable to use the authenticated requests in this collection. Automated token chaining is planned for Phase 5.

Purpose:
Invalidate the current session/access token.

Method:
POST

Endpoint:
/auth/logout

Authentication:
Required (Bearer {{authToken}}).

Parameters:
None.

Body:
None.

Expected response:
200 (inferred - determined from frontend source only, not exercised live).
401 if no/invalid token.

Note: not exercised live in Phase 2 to avoid invalidating a session without valid test credentials to re-authenticate.

Purpose:
Exchange a refresh token (cookie) for a new access token.

Method:
POST

Endpoint:
/auth/refresh

Authentication:
None via header - relies on a same-origin cookie set during login (the frontend sends every request with credentials: "include"). Postman will send/receive cookies for this domain automatically if 'Send cookies' is enabled and a prior login was performed in the same session/cookie jar.

Parameters:
None.

Body:
None (no request body is sent by the frontend client).

Expected response:
200 - { success: true, data: { accessToken } } (inferred, not observed live).
401 if no valid refresh cookie is present.

Note: refresh-token cookie attributes (name, httpOnly, Secure, SameSite, expiry) could not be determined in Phase 2 - no successful login was performed. See docs/API_DISCOVERY.md, Discovery Limitations.

Purpose:
Get the currently authenticated user.

Method:
GET

Endpoint:
/auth/me

Authentication:
Required (Bearer {{authToken}}).

Parameters:
None.

Body:
None.

Expected response:
200 - { success: true, data: { ...user object... } } (inferred, not observed live).
401 - { success: false, error: { code: 'UNAUTHORIZED', message: 'Missing authentication' } } (verified live when no token is sent).

item.name: 02 - Products
item.description: Public product catalog endpoints and admin create/update/delete endpoints. Verified in Phase 2 API discovery.

request.description:
Purpose:
List all products in the catalog.

Method:
GET

Endpoint:
/products

Authentication:
Not required.

Parameters:
None - no pagination/filter/sort query parameters were found in the frontend client (see Discovery Limitations).

Body:
None.

Expected response:
200 - { success: true, data: [ { id, name, slug, description, price, stock, imageKey, imageUrl, isActive, createdAt, updatedAt } ] } (verified live).

request.description:
Purpose:
Get a single product by its slug.

Method:
GET

Endpoint:
/products/{slug}

Authentication:
Not required.

Parameters (path):
slug (string) - the product's URL slug, e.g. 'bluetooth-speaker'. Verified live: a numeric product id in this position returns 404 - the API expects the slug, not the id.

Body:
None.

Expected response:
200 - { success: true, data: { ...same shape as GET /products items... } } (verified live).
404 - { success: false, error: { code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: 'Product not found' } } (verified live).

request.description:
Purpose:
Create a new product (admin only).

Method:
POST

Endpoint:
/products

Authentication:
Required (Bearer {{authToken}}, admin privilege presumed).

Parameters:
None.

Body:
UNDETERMINED - see body comment. Only the unauthenticated 401 path was verified live in Phase 2.

Expected response:
200/201 (inferred).
401 - { success: false, error: { code: 'UNAUTHORIZED', message: 'Missing authentication' } } (verified live).

Status: partially implemented - method/URL/auth confirmed, body schema unresolved. See docs/POSTMAN_IMPLEMENTATION.md.

Purpose:
Update an existing product (admin only).

Method:
PATCH

Endpoint:
/products/{id}

Authentication:
Required (Bearer {{authToken}}, admin privilege presumed).

Parameters (path):
id - it was NOT confirmed in Phase 2 whether this update endpoint expects the numeric id or the slug (unlike GET /products/{slug}, which is confirmed to use the slug). {{productId}} is used as a best-effort placeholder; verify against the real API before use.

Body:
UNDETERMINED - see body comment.

Expected response:
200 (inferred). 401/404 possible.

Status: not exercised live in Phase 2 (would mutate real catalog data with an unconfirmed identifier type and body schema). See docs/POSTMAN_IMPLEMENTATION.md.

Purpose:
Delete a product (admin only).

Method:
DELETE

Endpoint:
/products/{id}

Authentication:
Required (Bearer {{authToken}}, admin privilege presumed).

Parameters (path):
id - identifier type (slug vs numeric id) not confirmed for this endpoint; see note on the Update Product request.

Body:
None.

Expected response:
200/204 (inferred). 401/404 possible.

Status: not exercised live in Phase 2 - this is a destructive operation and was not run against real catalog data without confirming the identifier type. This request is available for use but should not be run against production-like data without care.

item.name: 03 - Cart
item.description: Session-scoped shopping cart endpoints. Authenticated by the X-Session-ID header ({{sessionId}}), not by login - verified live to work for guest (unauthenticated) users. All requests in this folder were exercised live during Phase 2 discovery.

request.description:
Purpose:
Get the current session's cart.

Method:
GET

Endpoint:
/cart

Authentication:
Not Bearer-authenticated. Requires X-Session-ID header (verified live: missing it returns 400 VALIDATION_ERROR).

Parameters:
None.

Body:
None.

Expected response:
200 - { success: true, data: { items: [ { productId, quantity, product } ], totalItems, totalAmount } } (verified live).
400 - { success: false, error: { code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR', message: 'Missing X-Session-ID header' } } (verified live if header removed).

Purpose:
Add an item to the cart.

Method:
POST

Endpoint:
/cart/items

Authentication:
Not Bearer-authenticated. Requires X-Session-ID header.

Parameters:
None.

Body (required, JSON):
{ "productId": number (required), "quantity": number (optional, client default 1) } - verified live.

Expected response:
200 - { success: true, data: { productId, quantity, totalItems } } (verified live).
404 - { success: false, error: { code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: 'Product not found' } } if productId does not exist (verified live).

Purpose:
Update the quantity of an existing cart item.

Method:
PATCH

Endpoint:
/cart/items/{productId}

Authentication:
Not Bearer-authenticated. Requires X-Session-ID header.

Parameters (path):
productId (number) - the product's numeric id, e.g. 4 (verified live; note this differs from GET /products/{slug} which uses the slug).

Body (required, JSON):
{ "quantity": number (required) } - verified live.

Expected response:
200 - { success: true, data: { productId, quantity, totalItems } } (verified live).

Purpose:
Remove a single item from the cart.

Method:
DELETE

Endpoint:
/cart/items/{productId}

Authentication:
Not Bearer-authenticated. Requires X-Session-ID header.

Parameters (path):
productId (number) - verified live.

Body:
None.

Expected response:
200 - { success: true, data: { productId, removed: true, totalItems } } (verified live).

Purpose:
Remove all items from the cart.

Method:
DELETE

Endpoint:
/cart

Authentication:
Not Bearer-authenticated. Requires X-Session-ID header.

Parameters:
None.

Body:
None.

Expected response:
200 - { success: true, data: { cleared: true, totalItems: 0 } } (verified live).

item.name: 06 - Images
item.description: Image upload (admin) and static image serving. GET verified live; POST determined from frontend source only.

request.description:
Purpose:
Upload an image (used for product images).

Method:
POST

Endpoint:
/images

Authentication:
Required (Bearer {{authToken}}, admin privilege presumed).

Parameters:
None.

Body (multipart/form-data, determined from frontend source):
file (binary, required), folder (string, optional, default 'products').

Expected response:
200 (inferred). 401 possible.

Status: determined from frontend source only; not exercised live in Phase 2 (requires admin credentials and would upload a real file). Select a local file in the 'file' field before sending.

Purpose:
Serve a previously uploaded image (static asset).

Method:
GET

Endpoint:
/images/{folder}/{filename}

Authentication:
Not required.

Parameters (path):
folder (string, e.g. 'products'), filename (string) - verified live using a real image referenced by a product's imageUrl field.

Body:
None.

Expected response:
200 - binary image data (Content-Type: image/*, CORS Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *) (verified live).
404 if the file does not exist (not exercised, inferred from standard static-asset behavior).

item.name: 07 - Negative Tests
item.description: Reserved for Phase 4 - API Test Automation. Phase 2 discovery already surfaced several negative scenarios (missing X-Session-ID, invalid login credentials, missing auth, unknown product slug/id) which are captured as response examples on the relevant requests above. Formal negative-test requests with assertions will be added in Phase 4.

item.name: 08 - Cleanup
item.description: Reserved for future phases. Delete/clear operations for resources actually created during test runs (e.g. deleting a test product, clearing a test cart) already exist as individual requests in their respective resource folders (02 - Products, 03 - Cart). Phase 5 (Data Chaining) will sequence create -> use -> cleanup flows; this folder remains empty until then.
